ZFI_SV_OpeningBalance.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
    SourceLedger,
    CompanyCode,
    LedgerFiscalYear,
    GLAccount,
    ChartOfAccounts,
    ControllingArea,
    ProfitCenter,
    CostCenter,
    Segment,
    BusinessArea,
    FunctionalArea,
    Customer,
    Supplier,
    MasterFixedAsset,
    FixedAsset,
    AssetClass,
    PartnerCompany,
    PartnerProfitCenter,
    PartnerCostCenter,
    PartnerBusinessArea,
    PartnerSegment,
    CompanyCodeCurrency,
    GlobalCurrency,
 
    SUM("NetAmountInCoodeCrcy")
        AS OpeningBalanceInCoCodeCrcy,
 
    SUM("NetAmountInGlobalCrcy")
        AS OpeningBalanceInGlobalCrcy
 
FROM "ZFI_HL_TrialBalance"
 
WHERE
    "LedgerFiscalYear" < :IP_YEAR
    OR
    (
        "LedgerFiscalYear"  = :IP_YEAR
        AND
        "FiscalPeriod" < :IP_PERIOD
    )
 
GROUP BY
    SourceLedger,
    CompanyCode,
    LedgerFiscalYear,
    GLAccount,
    ChartOfAccounts,
    ControllingArea,
    ProfitCenter,
    CostCenter,
    Segment,
    BusinessArea,
    FunctionalArea,
    Customer,
    Supplier,
    MasterFixedAsset,
    FixedAsset,
    AssetClass,
    PartnerCompany,
    PartnerProfitCenter,
    PartnerCostCenter,
    PartnerBusinessArea,
    PartnerSegment,
    CompanyCodeCurrency,
    GlobalCurrency
